summary.answer: Common loadout caller constructs the restriction icon directly and can merge its own state predicates afterward. This constructor builds an initially hidden image. CharacterRestricted and OneAbilityVisible predicates are AlwaysFalse; Visible requires neither ShowDirectorPregame nor IsPublicWZLobby, then exact self isRestricted true. lobbyNav and isRestricted notifications reevaluate state. Hence its OWN Visible path is excluded when the cited IsPublicWZLobby predicate is true; that is a scoped source condition, not an exclusion of the whole constructor or caller overrides. Reset hides the image; linked visible companions show/change it. No close override is registered in this primary span. Optional PostLoadFunc then self return.
